julee-brooks.text: Supports "necessary tactical protections, like our partnership with the Sheriff's Department," alongside Wellness Center mental-health staffing with manageable caseloads and strong mandated-reporting and crisis protocols.

source.title: Ballotpedia: Julee Brooks (2026 Candidate Connection survey)

julee-brooks.text: Calls herself a Moms Demand Action candidate and backs "commonsense gun safety" as part of school safety.

source.title: Ballotpedia: Julee Brooks (2026 Candidate Connection survey)

julee-brooks.text: Wants to build on Hart's Career Technical Education, deepen the College of the Canyons partnership, expand apprenticeships, and see "real union training facilities in our area."

source.title: Ballotpedia: Julee Brooks (2026 Candidate Connection survey)

julee-brooks.text: Says Hart faces unique funding pressures as a high-school-only district; promises budget discipline and transparency and to "bring new funding ideas to district leadership."

source.title: Ballotpedia: Julee Brooks (2026 Candidate Connection survey)

julee-brooks.text: Supports "strong instruction in science, history, and civics," and, as a special-needs parent, disability policy ensuring public-education access for students of all abilities.

source.title: Ballotpedia: Julee Brooks (2026 Candidate Connection survey)

bryan-biggers.text: Says the district doesn't have to choose between rigorous academics and trades: students wanting a demanding AP load should get it, and those who want to build things deserve "a real technical pathway that leads to a career, not just a leftover elective."

source.title: Bryan Biggers for Hart School Board, Trustee Area 2 (campaign site)

bryan-biggers.text: "Teachers are the engine of our schools — not a line item, the engine. Support them, keep them, and back them up."

source.title: Bryan Biggers for Hart School Board, Trustee Area 2 (campaign site)

bryan-biggers.text: On safety: "Resource officers and real support matter — but culture matters more," defining safety as every student having one adult on campus who knows their name.

source.title: Bryan Biggers for Hart School Board, Trustee Area 2 (campaign site)

bryan-biggers.text: Wants a board that treats parents as partners, "providing straight answers, and keeping budgets open and transparent."
